title: Contiguous Array
description:
Given a binary array `nums` containing only `0`s and `1`s, return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray with an equal number of `0` and `1`.

A subarray is a contiguous non-empty sequence of elements within an array. If no non-empty subarray has an equal number of `0`s and `1`s, return `0`.
hints: Replace every 0 with -1 mentally: a subarray has an equal number of 0s and 1s if and only if its transformed sum is 0.
Track the running prefix balance as you scan left to right. If the same balance appears at two indices i and j (i < j), the subarray (i, j] has net balance 0.
Store only the earliest index where each balance was seen (initializing balance 0 at index -1) to maximize the subarray length.

examples.explanation: [0, 1] is the longest contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0 and 1, with length 2.
[0, 1] (or [1, 0]) is a longest contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0 and 1, with length 2.
The subarray [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0] (indices 3 through 8) has three 1s and three 0s, giving a maximum length of 6.
